name: ml-repo
description: Whole-repository maintenance. cleanup audits a repo for dead, duplicated, generated, stale and over-engineered code and docs, then removes and simplifies it without changing behaviour: evidence for every claim of dead, refactors only where a test covers the code, live-state-safe changes for infrastructure code, dry-run blind spots covered, and the result shipped as a deletions-only PR plus reviewable PRs per area.
